scope_difference: PR1333 prices every affine homogeneous-rank-one address label as one unit, including the swap. This result restricts labels to the two coordinate CNOTs and proves exact cost six for two swaps with any finite number of restored dirty registers. Other listed register results concern rational abelian or Clifford/complex address alphabets.
